title: ws-presence-update (both directions)

run_id.description: App to server only, and only with state in_game: the run being played. The server counts play time per run when the user joined that run with this game, otherwise it ignores it. Never broadcast.

description: App to server: {state: online|in_game, game_id?, run_id?}. Server to apps: additionally user_id and device_id (always set), state may be offline; run_id is never sent to other apps.
